title: steel grid turns to chrome on the change
story: A grid of metal objects in a dark room, rough and dim while the centroid sits low: the kick pushes the camera in (dist 5.5 -> 4.6) and shakes, the snare rocks the objects a quarter radian and flashes the contrast. At the harmonic change (3960) the bright centroid and the rising RMS turn the objects to chrome over one bar, the light swings and the hazard highlights come in. From there the camera cuts every two bars to a new station and the drums carry on in the same two carriers, with the big hits (4066, 4189) punching both and the fov.
